root_cause: The target's server_hello() fixture built methods from Method::ALL, which includes four reserved tags (Diagnostics, RefMoveProtected, TestsSelected, TestsAffected); Hello::validate rejects reserved tags, so server.validate() failed every negotiate_identity call with PayloadInvalid and the Ok arm never executed. Wiring the negotiation oracle into check_frame exposed this: deterministic seed seed-0004 (the accepted fixture server hello, a valid hello) failed negotiation. Fixed by filtering reserved tags from the fixture; the minimized input now negotiates Ok.
disposition: server_hello() filters reserved method tags and asserts validity on every negotiation (fail loud on fixture drift); the Err arm accepts only NoCommonProfile (Hello::decode validates, so PayloadInvalid is unreachable with a valid fixture); the negotiate() doc sentence on validation failures is an S20-410 doc-accuracy request (decision packet round-7-smp1-negotiate).
expected: The minimized input (accepted server hello frame) executes without panic and reaches the Ok negotiation arm; negotiation failures carry NoCommonProfile, never an unlisted code.
